code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    row_regions = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1) if row_bounds[i]+1 < row_bounds[i+1]]
    col_regions = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1) if col_bounds[i]+1 < col_bounds[i+1]]
    for r0, r1 in row_regions:
        occupied = []
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_regions):
            cells = [(r, c-c0, grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != 0]
            if cells:
                occupied.append((j, cells))
        if len(occupied) != 1:
            continue
        j, cells = occupied[0]
        # The reflected copy is placed toward the center of the divided grid.
        target_j = j + 1 if j < (len(col_regions)-1)/2 else j - 1
        if target_j < 0 or target_j >= len(col_regions):
            continue
        tc0, tc1 = col_regions[target_j]
        # Reflection is across the wall separating the source and target cells.
        for r, local_c, color in cells:
            reflected_local = (col_regions[j][1] - col_regions[j][0] - 1) - local_c
            c = tc0 + reflected_local
            if tc0 <= c < tc1 and out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.read_text())

newcode='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    rows = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1) if rb[i]+1 < rb[i+1]]
    cols = [(cb[i]+1, cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1) if cb[i]+1 < cb[i+1]]
    for ri in range(len(rows)-1):
        r0, r1 = rows[ri], rows[ri+1]
        rh = r0[1]-r0[0]
        if rh != r1[1]-r1[0]:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(cols)-1):
            c0, c1 = cols[ci], cols[ci+1]
            cw = c0[1]-c0[0]
            if cw != c1[1]-c1[0]:
                continue
            positions = [(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)]
            shapes = []
            colors = set()
            for rr, cc in positions:
                d = {}
                for r in range(rr[0], rr[1]):
                    for c in range(cc[0], cc[1]):
                        v = grid[r][c]
                        if v:
                            d.setdefault(v, set()).add((r-rr[0], c-cc[0]))
                shapes.append(d)
                colors.update(d)
            for color in colors:
                occupied = [k for k,d in enumerate(shapes) if color in d]
                if len(occupied) != 3:
                    continue
                canonical = []
                for k in occupied:
                    a, b = divmod(k, 2)
                    canonical.append({(rh-1-y if a else y, cw-1-x if b else x) for y,x in shapes[k][color]})
                if not all(s == canonical[0] for s in canonical[1:]):
                    continue
                missing = next(k for k in range(4) if k not in occupied)
                a, b = divmod(missing, 2)
                rr, cc = positions[missing]
                cells = [(rr[0]+(rh-1-y if a else y), cc[0]+(cw-1-x if b else x), color) for y,x in canonical[0]]
                if all(out[r][c] == 0 for r,c,_ in cells):
                    for r,c,v in cells:
                        out[r][c] = v
    return out
'''
